summary.oneLiner: Ramky Infrastructure Limited has received a credit rating upgrade from IVR BBB- to IVR BBB with a stable outlook, indicating a moderate degree of safety regarding timely servicing of financial obligations. The company's operational and financial performance for FY25 and 9M-FY26 have been taken into account. The upgrade reflects the company's improved credit profile, with a total bank facility of Rs. 706.47 crores. The company's focus on sustainable infrastructure and green buildings is expected to drive growth in the future.

themes.title: Infrastructure EPC & roads order-book conversion
themes.need: India's record capital-outlay cycle (roads, metro, marine, hydro, tunnelling) gives diversified EPC contractors multi-year visibility - AFCONS tracks a ~INR4 lakh cr pipeline (70% domestic) and targets ~INR30,000cr FY27 inflow; NCC/DBL/PNCINFRA/GRINFRA/ASHOKA/CEIGALL carry large road/HAM books; AFCONS/PATELENG/AHLUCONT/PSPPROJECT add marine, hydro and building EPC. The binding issue is execution + client-payment cycles, not order intake.
themes.driver: L1-to-firm-order conversion (AFCONS Croatia/Vadhavan, DMRC awards); NHAI/HAM award pickup; monsoon-end execution ramp.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Describes itself as "One of few leading ISO certified EPC Company in India", public listed since 2010, with three decades of experience across DBFOT, EPC, HAM, BTS and BOT O&M contracting models in what it calls the Sustainable Infrastructure Space.
- States its "Current focus sectors are in Industrial; Water & Waste Water; Urban Solutions". The separate "Key Business Verticals / What We Do" slide surfaces only INDUSTRIAL and URBAN SOLUTIONS as vertical headings, with Industrial Parks, Development, Infrastructure, Residential & Commercial Buildings and Data Centers listed as activities; the extraction does not preserve which activity sits under which vertical, so the mapping is not asserted here.
- Claimed competitive advantages are listed as a slide of labels only, with no supporting metrics: Strong Management, Consistent Profitability, Positive Cash Flow from Operations, Growth Potential, Risk Mitigation, Effective WC Management, Enhanced Order Book Mix, Nil Term Debt Company, and Technology & Innovation.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Order book] Standalone slide shows a CLOSING ORDER BOOK of INR 9,000 Cr; the consolidated slide shows ORDER INFLOW of INR 12,500 Cr. These are two differently-labelled metrics (closing book vs inflow) at two different reporting levels and should not be read as the same figure.
- [Period labelling] Both headline slides are titled "Key Numbers Standalone: Q1 FY 25-26" and "Key Numbers Consolidated: Q1 FY 25-26" while the covering letter states the presentation is for the quarter ended 30.06.2026 and the charts are labelled Q1FY27 — the deck contradicts itself on the period label.
- [Contact/identity] Ramky Infrastructure Limited, CIN L74210TG1994PLC017356, headquartered at Ramky Grandiose, Gachibowli, Hyderabad; BSE scrip 533262, NSE symbol RAMKY; presentation signed by Rayapudi Sravanth, Chief Financial Officer.
